quote: Our focus in this paper is a particularly challenging dataset for meaning-sensitive behavior: COMPS, which contains minimal pair sentences that test the ability of LMs on property knowledge of everyday concepts and their inheritance for novel concepts.

We investigate the extent to which in-context examples and instructions—key components that drive impressive performance in contemporary LMs—can overcome important limitations of LMs at tests that have poked holes in their ability to extract conceptual meaning from text.
outputs: Generated conclusions or answers for property inheritance tasks, such as attributing properties to novel concepts in declarative statements or QA responses.
The models generate text to complete statements or answer questions about property inheritance of novel concepts based on analogies to known concepts.
